Court Convicts Ex-AAP Councillor Tahir Hussain in 2020 Delhi Riots Case

A court has convicted former Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) Councillor Tahir Hussain for abetment of rioting in connection with the 2020 Northeast Delhi riots. The conviction relates to a case linked to the riots.
